# White Rose eTheses Online

> A collaborative open-access institutional repository for doctoral theses from the University of Sheffield, University of York, and University of Leeds, built on the EPrints platform.

White Rose eTheses Online is a shared digital archive managed by White Rose Libraries that enables postgraduate researchers to deposit and discover doctoral theses across three major UK universities. The repository provides open access to academic research while supporting researchers with deposit guidance, access restrictions, and copyright management.

## Getting Started

- [Welcome to White Rose eTheses Online](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk): Homepage for White Rose eTheses Online, collaborative thesis repository of three UK universities
- [About this service](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/information.html): Overview of White Rose eTheses Online service, mission, and partnerships
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/faq.html): FAQ addressing thesis deposit, account creation, and open-access guidelines
- [Contact Information](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/contact.html): Contact details for support with thesis deposit and repository issues

## Depositing Theses

- [Depositing your thesis](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/deposit.html): Guide for doctoral students on how to deposit theses in the repository
- [Restricted theses](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/restricted.html): Guidance on thesis access restrictions, embargoes, and commercialization
- [Copyright and Reuse information](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/copyright.html): Copyright policy and Creative Commons licensing information for theses

## Browse & Discover

- [Browse by Year](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/view/year): Browse thesis repository contents by year with chronological filtering
- [Latest 20 Additions](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/cgi/latest_tool): Display of latest 20 thesis submissions to the White Rose repository
- [Repository Statistics](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/cgi/stats/report): Repository analytics and usage statistics dashboard for eTheses Online

## Related Resources

- [Other sources of theses](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/other_sources.html): Links to alternative thesis repositories including British Library EThOS

## Policies & Legal

- [Takedown Policy](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/takedown.html): Content removal and intellectual property complaint process policy
- [Privacy and data protection](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/privacy_and_data_protection.html): GDPR compliance and data protection policy for user accounts
- [Accessibility](https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/accessibility.html): WCAG compliance and accessibility features for repository users
